start_command: cd backend && python eva_start.py --install --port 45105 & cd frontend && npm run dev -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 45205
$readiness_comment: Use the checkout-local Python bootstrap, not global Uvicorn. A bounded first-run install may precede backend readiness; then warm the Next frontend. The backend-health journey uses the browser adapter and verifies the actual frontend-to-backend proxy instead of declaring a CLI command that the web adapter never executed.

no diagnostic, clinical, or therapeutic claims
no loading of the gitignored real omics data (the ~79MB real_data/ is never touched)
no npm run lint (hangs on interactive ESLint setup) — never invoked anywhere
